content: SwiftShader (google/swiftshader): Apache License 2.0. A high-performance CPU-based implementation of the Vulkan 1.3 API itself (an ICD/driver-level software Vulkan implementation, not an application-level rendering library/engine). Builds via CMake, vendors its own third_party deps as git submodules (same convention as this project's thirdparty/). Actively maintained by Google, builds for Windows/Linux/macOS/Android/Chrome.
